title: Customer feedback triage
emptyList: No tickets yet. Submit customer feedback to create a ticket you can reopen here.
composeHelp: Keep the customer’s wording. AI will cite their feedback when it drafts a recommendation for your review.
sourcePlaceholder: Paste what the customer experienced, tried, or expected.
invalidSource: Enter between 10 and 2,400 characters of original customer feedback.
draftHelp: The original feedback is saved and ready for analysis.
analyzingHelp: The original feedback is saved. The page will update when the model returns its recommendation.
reviewHelp: Compare the evidence with the original feedback, then confirm the issue and next step.
confirmedHelp: The recommendation has been reviewed and saved.
model_unavailable: The model is temporarily unavailable. The original feedback is saved in this ticket. Try again later.
invalid_model_output: The model’s response failed the format or evidence check. You can retry on this ticket.
failedHelp: Analysis failed. The original feedback is saved and you can retry.
errorInvalidResponse: The workbench returned unexpected data. Refresh the tickets.
errorConflict: The ticket changed. Refresh the tickets to continue.
errorMissing: This ticket is no longer available. Refresh the list.
errorTimeout: The request timed out. Refresh the tickets to check whether the operation was saved.
errorConnection: The workbench could not complete the request. Refresh the tickets and try again.
